concurrent_work: During review, uncommitted deferred-adjoint changes appeared in placement/lp.py and placement/thermal.py. They were preserved. This evidence and the focused tests refer to the published snapshot, not the concurrent draft.
scope: Published snapshot review. No production-code changes or remote experiment operations. Controlled failures are not claims about the frequency of natural solver failures.

validation.ordinary_no_start_control: The previous two 6x6 mm dies on a 10x10 mm trial carrier now return not_found with 0 FV, rather than raising.

wire_feasible_candidate_overwritten.kind: Injected MILP incumbents and clock, real geometry, pin lengths and FV certification
wire_feasible_candidate_overwritten.limit_recipe: Every die limit is Evaluator(problem, 0, resolution=16).peaks_c([axial])[0] + 1 C.
wire_feasible_candidate_overwritten.clock_recipe: Patch time.perf_counter to a mutable clock initially 0. Mock milp_relations to return axial, then polygon, setting status=time_limit each time and advancing clock by 1 then 2 seconds. fixed_carrier uses model=object(), start=None, time_s=3, threads=1, directions=8. No real wall-clock delay or claimed Gurobi timing result.

unexpected_runtime_error_hidden.kind: Fault injection after one actual FV solve
unexpected_runtime_error_hidden.recipe: Patch cosize.fit_into to None, run_sizing.sample_legal and length_descent to the legal layout. Replace METHODS['relation_space'] with a function that runs run.evaluate([layout]), records evaluator.solves, then raises RuntimeError('injected numerical failure after one FV solve'). Call try_carrier with gap_um=500, length_m=1, model=relation_space, budget=10, size_s=1, threads/workers=1, resolution=64, chain_steps=1, seed=2, rs_share=5.

relation_space_initialization_exhausts_t.kind: Real initialization and FV evaluation; search entry points instrumented
relation_space_initialization_exhausts_t.recipe: run_front(problem, gap_um=500, budget=20, seed=2, extra_starts=[layout], method_options={milp_s:0.1, workers:1, anneal_steps:0, chains:1}); instrument methods.slp_chain and TopologyLP.sweep with wrappers. Geometric seed preprocessing is shortened to keep the control cheap; the 24+24 initialization layout counts and FV ordering are unchanged.
relation_space_initialization_exhausts_t.allocation_recipe: From local imported Case1/Case6 inputs, calculate anchored(inner=relation_space)'s 999//number_of_aspects budget, then area_ceiling, trial_areas and max(2, family_budget//(number_of_trials+REFINE)); default CostParams, envelope=1.25. No new FV evaluation on these two cases.
relation_space_initialization_exhausts_t.qualification: Applies when the mapped start fails certification and initialization supplies enough distinct thermal layouts; tight carriers with failed sampling can follow a different path. No claim that every formal run degenerates.
